shared.fallback: Button not opening? Use this link instead.
shared.securityNotice: If you did not make this change, reset your password from your workspace sign-in page and contact your workspace administrator.

templates.subject: You are invited to ZeeSpare
templates.title: Your invitation to ZeeSpare
templates.preheader: You are invited to ZeeSpare. Accept your invitation to get started.
templates.body: Someone invited you to plan service parts with them in ZeeSpare. Accept the invitation to join your team.
templates.note: This link expires in one hour. Your invitation stays open for 7 days. If the link expires, ask the person who invited you to resend it.
templates.safety: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

templates.subject: Sign in to ZeeSpare
templates.title: Sign in to ZeeSpare
templates.preheader: Your one-time ZeeSpare sign-in link is ready. It expires in one hour.
templates.body: Use your secure link to sign in to ZeeSpare. If you were invited to an organization, your invitation opens after you sign in.
templates.note: This link works once and expires in one hour. Keep it private and only use it if you expected this email.
templates.safety: If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it.

templates.subject: Reset your ZeeSpare password
templates.title: Reset your password
templates.preheader: Reset your ZeeSpare password with a one-time link, valid for one hour.
templates.body: We received a request to reset your ZeeSpare password. Choose a new password to get back to your workspace.
templates.note: This link works once and expires in one hour. Your password will only change after you choose and save a new one.
templates.safety: If you did not request a password reset, you can ignore this email. Your password has not changed.

templates.subject: Confirm your ZeeSpare email change
templates.title: Confirm your email change
templates.preheader: Confirm the requested change to your ZeeSpare email address.
templates.body: A change to your ZeeSpare email address was requested. Confirm this request using the button below.
templates.note: For your security, confirmation is required from both your current and new email addresses. Check both inboxes to finish the change.
templates.safety: If you did not request this change, do not confirm it. Reset your password from your workspace sign-in page and contact your workspace administrator.

templates.subject: Your ZeeSpare verification code
templates.title: Verify it's you
templates.preheader: Use your ZeeSpare verification code to confirm it is you.
templates.body: Enter this verification code in the ZeeSpare window where you requested it to continue.
templates.note: Only enter it in your workspace. Never forward this email or share the code with anyone.
templates.safety: If you did not request this code, you can ignore this email.

templates.subject: Your ZeeSpare password was changed
templates.title: Your password has been updated.
templates.preheader: A password change was completed for your ZeeSpare account.
templates.body: The password for your ZeeSpare account was changed. If you made this change, no further action is needed.

templates.subject: Your ZeeSpare email address was changed
templates.title: Your email address is updated.
templates.preheader: An email address change was completed for your ZeeSpare account.
templates.body: The email address used to sign in to your ZeeSpare account was changed. If you made this change, use your new email address next time you sign in.

templates.subject: Your ZeeSpare phone number was changed
templates.title: Your phone number is updated.
templates.preheader: A phone number change was completed for your ZeeSpare account.
templates.body: The phone number associated with your ZeeSpare account was changed. If you made this change, no further action is needed.

templates.subject: A sign-in method was added to ZeeSpare
templates.title: A sign-in method was added.
templates.preheader: A sign-in method was linked to your ZeeSpare account.
templates.body: A new sign-in method was linked to your ZeeSpare account. If you made this change, no further action is needed.

templates.subject: A sign-in method was removed from ZeeSpare
templates.title: A sign-in method was removed.
templates.preheader: A sign-in method was unlinked from your ZeeSpare account.
templates.body: A sign-in method was removed from your ZeeSpare account. If you made this change, use one of your remaining methods next time you sign in.

templates.subject: A verification method was added to ZeeSpare
templates.title: Another layer of protection.
templates.preheader: A verification method was added to your ZeeSpare account.
templates.body: A multi-factor verification method was added to your ZeeSpare account. If you made this change, keep that method available for your next sign-in.

templates.subject: A verification method was removed from ZeeSpare
templates.title: A verification method was removed.
templates.preheader: A verification method was removed from your ZeeSpare account.
templates.body: A multi-factor verification method was removed from your ZeeSpare account. If you made this change, no further action is needed.
